title: Attendance Requirement
content: Students must maintain at least 75% attendance to be eligible to write the semester examination. Students between 65% and 74% may be considered for condonation according to college rules. Below 65% may result in detention.

title: Grading Policy
content: Course grades are based on internal assessment and the end-semester examination. The pass requirement is determined by the applicable academic regulations.

title: Re-Examination / Supplementary Exam Policy
content: Students who are eligible under the applicable academic regulations may register for a supplementary or re-examination opportunity after the regular examination period. Registration deadlines and fees are announced by the college.

title: Leave of Absence Policy
content: Students should obtain approval for extended academic leave through the appropriate college office. Approved leave does not automatically waive attendance or assessment requirements unless the regulations provide for it.

title: Code of Conduct — Examinations
content: Students must follow examination-room instructions and college examination conduct requirements. Unauthorized materials, communication, or misconduct may lead to disciplinary action.

title: Fee Payment & Late Fee Policy
content: Semester fees should be paid by the announced deadline. Late payment may attract a late fee or other administrative restriction according to the current college notice.

title: CS201 — Data Structures
content: CS201 covers arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, hashing, graphs, sorting, searching, and algorithmic complexity.

title: CS305 — Database Systems
content: CS305 covers relational database concepts, SQL, normalization, transactions, indexing, query processing, and database design.

title: MA202 — Probability & Statistics
content: MA202 covers probability distributions, random variables, sampling, estimation, hypothesis testing, correlation, and regression.

title: Hall Ticket
content: Hall tickets are normally made available through the student examination portal after eligibility and fee requirements are cleared. If your hall ticket is missing close to the examination, contact the examination office.

title: Transcript
content: Students can request official transcripts through the academic or examination office using the college's prescribed process.

title: Hostel
content: Hostel allocation and room-related requests are handled by the hostel administration. Availability depends on the current allocation cycle.

title: Lost Student ID
content: Report a lost student ID to the relevant student-services or administration office and follow the replacement procedure.

title: Elective Change
content: Elective changes are subject to the academic calendar, seat availability, and department approval. Check the current academic notice before submitting a request.

title: Mid-Semester Exam Schedule
content: The mid-semester examination schedule is published by the examination office. Students should verify course-wise dates and sessions in the official schedule.

title: Fee Payment Deadline Extended
content: The semester fee payment deadline has been extended according to the latest administrative notice. Students should check the official notice for the final date.

title: Placement Drive
content: A campus placement drive is scheduled for eligible students. Students should review the placement office notice for company eligibility and registration details.

title: Library Extended Hours
content: The library has extended operating hours during the examination preparation period. Students should follow the latest library notice for the current schedule.

title: Technical Fest
content: The annual technical fest includes workshops, competitions, and student activities. Registration information is published by the event organizers.
